name: VariableFixingOutput

semantics.free_variables: variable names retained in the downstream optimizer search space
semantics.fixed_variables: source-incumbent values removed from the downstream optimizer search space
semantics.variable_assessments: one concise fix-or-free decision for each design variable

free_variables: list of remaining allowed keys; disjoint from fixed_variables and exhaustive with it
fixed_variables: object with allowed keys x_chem, x_T, x_S, x_MPR, x_R; every value must equal the source incumbent
invariant: fixed keys union free names equals x_chem, x_T, x_S, x_MPR, x_R; intersection is empty; len(free_variables) >= 1; fixed values equal source values
partition_rule: all-fixed is invalid; at least one variable must be free
warnings: list of concrete uncertainty strings; use [] when there is no concrete uncertainty
